candidate_ledger.output_variable_reasoning: For the Blasius laminar boundary layer, the streamwise velocity normalized by free-stream, u/U, is a function of the similarity variable eta = y * sqrt(U/(nu x)). Dimensional analysis with the listed inputs (U, ν, x, y) shows one dimensionless group combining y, U, ν, x: eta; hence u/U = f(eta). This yields u/U dimensionless (no SI exponents), so the dependence is correctly captured by the provided inputs.
